title: 第一卷 第323章 该干嘛干嘛
slug: 纨绔世子爷公主退婚我造反
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

陈炎在铺子里转了一圈。

破桌子、旧板凳、墙上的纸都卷边了。

这种地方，别说百姓不愿意送孩子来。

搁他自己，也不想来。

“林修。”

“在。”

“明天安排一下。”

“我要见这个刘正平。”

林修一愣。

“世子要亲自去？”

陈炎笑了。

“老子这辈子最烦两种人。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Chen Yan walked around the shop.

Broken tables, old benches, and paper on the walls are all curled.

Not to mention that people are unwilling to send their children to a place like this.

He didn't want to come even if he was alone.

"Lin Xiu."

"Here."

"Let's make arrangements tomorrow."

"I want to see this Liu Zhengping."

Lin Xiu was stunned.

"The prince wants to go in person?"

Chen Yan smiled.

"There are two types of people that annoy me the most in my life."
